intro: Auberdine is a coastal night elven port town on the gloomy shores of Darkshore, serving as the Alliance's primary maritime gateway to northern Kalimdor. Sheltered beneath overcast skies and pine-covered bluffs, it connects the island home of Teldrassil to the Eastern Kingdoms while serving as an administrative haven against the encroaching wilderness.

p: Resting along the shores of the Veiled Sea, Auberdine is the only major settlement to successfully endure in modern Darkshore. Unlike the secluded treetop cities of Teldrassil, Auberdine looks outward, serving as the Alliance's busiest port in the north. Regular ships sail between here and the Eastern Kingdoms, to Stormwind Harbor and, by way of Southshore, to Menethil Harbor, while local ferries run to Rut'theran Village at the boughs of the World Tree. Because of its trade role, Auberdine embraces a more cosmopolitan air than traditional elven enclaves; visitors find lamps illuminating stone-laid streets and outland merchants including dwarves and gnomes mingling among the low-slung, arched timber houses.

Governed by elder Thundris Windweaver and the Auberdine Village Council, the town coordinates the defence of Darkshore alongside the local Sentinels. Despite its role as a vital trade hub, Auberdine's name is rarely spoken in the boughs of Darnassus, where memory dwells on the great cities the Sundering took. The town endures relentless regional perils: aggressive murlocs raid the fishing boats along the strand, corrupted Blackwood furbolgs press from the south, and foul magic seeping down from Felwood agitates the local wildlife.
